hero.title: Celebrating the launch
body: In 2020, SpaceX returned America's ability to fly NASA astronauts to and from the International Space Station on American vehicles.
The SpaceXIPO coin celebrates the launch of $SPCX.

sections.title: $SPCX
body: SpaceX was listed on the Nasdaq under the ticker symbol $SPCX on June 12, 2026. The company intended to raise $75 billion by selling 555.6 million shares at $135 apiece, targeting a mind-boggling valuation of roughly $1.75 trillion. However, after a day of trading the stock now values the company at $2.1 trillion.

sections.title: A non-traditional offering
body: Unlike standard IPOs where financial institutions dominate, SpaceX is offering individual investors up to 30% of the deal at the same price. Brokerages like Robinhood, Fidelity, and SoFi have lowered their minimum participation requirements to as little as $2,000.
Because of the listing's enormous scale, the Nasdaq-100 has created a new fast-entry rule allowing SpaceX to join the benchmark after just 15 days of trading.

sections.title: From Launch to Orbit
body: SpaceXIPO coin is intended to sustain growth by transitioning from initial hype to continuous trading activity..
